desc: Long time no upload! So this is just a distant explosion sound effect that I made in Audacity. What I did was knock on my desk, slow it down a lot, add reverb, some paulstretch, equalization, and done. Also, happy new year! :D I guess it also sounds like a big distant firework too. You're free to use this however, and wherever you want, (as long as you give me proper credit and/or claim that you didn't make it.) I might upload more sounds, just maybe.
title: Distant Explosion
author: Mr_KeybOred
